verdict.rationale: Thoropass's only documented programmatic surface is its official MCP server. It covers a narrow slice of the UI: listing audits and their details, listing evidence requests and their linked systems, and adding comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests. Nothing in the pack documents a general API spanning the UI's many other features (risk register, policies, access reviews, controls, monitors, user management). missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, API coverage of risk register/policies/access reviews/controls/monitors/user administration, any stated UI-API parity commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
